title: Service Center and Service Notes
summary: This topic combines opinions about dealer or customer service quality with many administrative mentions of service notes that do not state a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise dealer and customer service as great, fantastic, or excellent.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe service as poor, not good, disappointing, or the worst.

mixed.summary: The mixed review includes praise for the service side but the sample does not provide the offsetting negative detail in the selected fragment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention service status or service notes without enough detail to judge the experience.

limitations: The topic mixes evaluative service experience comments with non-evaluative service-note and in-service status mentions.
Most sampled fragments are very short, which limits detail about specific service issues or strengths.
A large share of reviews in this topic are undetermined, so the examples do not support a more specific thematic summary.
